system.description:
You take a withdrawn stance gripping your weapon and prepare for a powerful sweeping strike. You spend your turn preparing this attack until the beginning of your next turn. You cannot take a Bonus action the turn you use this jutsu or a reaction after using this jutsu. At the start of your next turn, you swing with all of your force, all creatures in front of you within 5 feet, must make a Dexterity saving throw at disadvantage, taking your [Weapons damage] + 5d12 damage.

Chain 2: You can still take your Reactions.

Chain 3: If a creature fails their saving throw by 5 or more, you can cast another Bukijutsu using the same weapon, of C-Rank or lower, with a casting time as 1 Action, as a Bonus Action.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d12. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, at the start of your next turn, you can select a space within your movement range that can hold you and move into that space before this jutsu’s effect triggers.
